{{Quote|I have contacted Gavra Ubrento at her shop. She has promised what she can spare, but it is not much.|Kaya Gimm|<ref name="Guardians of the Whills" />}}
'''Gavra Ubrento''' was a [[Gender|female]]<ref name="Guardians of the Whills" /> [[human]] [[Technician|mechanic]] part of a roving crew that offered repair services. Despite a lack of access to state-of-the-art technical tools and facilities, Ubrento was skilled at keeping [[starship]] propulsion systems functional.<ref name="UVG" /> Ubrento had done business with the droid mechanic [[Kaya Gimm]]. When Kaya and her sister [[Killi Gimm|Killi]] were driven from their [[Gimm sisters' orphanage|orphanage]] by the [[Galactic Empire]], Ubrento promised to spare a few supplies to help them resettle.<ref name="Guardians of the Whills" /> Ubrento was present in [[Jedha City]] shortly before it was [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroyed]] by the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]].<ref name="Rogue One">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>

Ubrento was pictured by [[probe droid]] [[V0-RK]] while it was on Jedha hunting for signs of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]],<ref name="Datapad">{{DatapadCite|V0-RK|V0RKp1-GEDatapad.png|V0RKp2-GEDatapad.png}}</ref> but the [[Echo Base|Rebel base]] was actually located on [[Hoth]] and found by [[XJ9-CS14]].<ref name="TESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>
